programs.title: Infomercials
programs.desc: TVNZ 1 is a major New Zealand free-to-air television channel operated by the state-owned Television New Zealand. It broadcasts a broad mix of programming, primarily focusing on news, current affairs, drama, entertainment, and factual shows.

programs.title: Rural Delivery
programs.desc: Massey University investigates pasture species in regen ag; Fruit producers and workers alike harvest benefits of the RSE scheme; and Massey’s Horticulture Society grows opportunities for students.

programs.title: Barkley Manor
programs.desc: Portia the ageing Shih Tsu dons her best dress for the Barkley Manor VIP Room. Plus, Reggie the staffie pup goes on a rampage and an anxious Labradoodle face her greatest fear.

programs.title: Tagata Pasifika
programs.desc: Tagata Pasifika is TVNZ's flagship Pacific news show, telling the stories of Pacific Islanders and its community. Made with the support of NZ on Air.

programs.title: Songs Of Praise
programs.desc: Inspiring hymns and songs, together with uplifting stories of faith from around the UK and beyond.

programs.title: Susan Calman's Grand Day Out
programs.desc: Susan and her campervan Helen are heading back to an old favourite, Yorkshire. She finds that the dales and moors contain a few unexplored spots and a few surprises that are a joy to discover.

programs.title: Q+A With Jack Tame
programs.desc: Hosted by Jack Tame, Q+A brings viewers the important political interviews and discussions of the week, taking a close look at politics, economics, and global events.

programs.title: Waka Huia
programs.desc: Waka Huia is an iconic archival documentary series recording the unique stories and histories of Maori for all New Zealanders.

programs.title: Marae
programs.desc: Your way in to the Māori world and the issues that matter. Māiatanga, Whanaungatanga, Manaakitanga - We bring you stories with heart.

programs.title: The Great British Bake Off Extra Slice
programs.desc: Prue Leith, Oti Mabuse and Jon Richardson enjoy the last slice of the series. Which baker took their French delights to dizzy new heights? And whose biggest cake in history took showstopping victory?

programs.title: Find My Country House
programs.desc: Catriona helps devoted mum Abby find her dream home in Heathcote's wine country. They tour an olive grove retreat, a sprawling equestrian estate, and a family home with a hidden surprise.

programs.title: Jamie's Air Fryer Meals
programs.desc: Jamie transforms frozen fish into prosciutto-baked bliss, creates a roast chicken dinner curry, and takes things up a notch with a peach Alaska dessert.
